correctness.rationale: If f²=e, commutation and invertibility on the fixed points force their unique order reversal and hence mirrored target intervals. Measuring outward on paired rails gives nondecreasing maps a,b with a_B=b_A=0, where A=max a and B=max b; those two tests suffice by monotonicity. Independently count a total of j positive image values by splitting j=j_a+j_b. In the first rail choose j positions: the first j_b entries are the positive values of b, and the last j_a entries are positive-run starts of a. The endpoint condition is exactly that the latter occur after the former; analogously on the second rail take j_a values of a followed by j_b run starts of b. Assign the run values in increasing order. This gives a bijection for every split, including empty ones, hence the stated H. Distinct target rails contribute disjoint excess image points and use each side length once, even in the central fiber. Summing binomial coefficients gives the double generating function and its diagonal at z; ordered side lengths describe all idempotents without quotienting by symmetries. With k roots, [v^(r−k)] of H(z,z;v)^k gives binomial(2k+r−k−1,r−k) times z^(2(r−k))/(1−z)^(2r), yielding the second binomial after the k roots are accounted for. An isotone square root fixes all roots (the only increasing bijection there), so f² idempotent is equivalent in that class to f³=f². On each one-sided rail the positive image values all precede the positive run starts, giving binomial(a,2j); the square of its one-rail generating function equals the antitone diagonal. The empty-map and rank boundary conventions agree. The additional independent exhaustive local check using the pointwise return equations matched all coefficients for 0≤L,R≤3.
residual_risks: Bounded computation corroborates the rail kernel only; the all-size result rests on the symbolic classification and count.

checked_sources: The fixed-target constant example and independent rail proof
value.rationale: The exact fixed-target polynomial gives information a square-root count from total rank or block sizes cannot recover, and it solves the order constraint for all labelled finite chains. The relation between global antitone and isotone ranks is useful precisely because their fixed-target distributions differ. The result also identifies the two-cycles on the square's image without imposing regularity or injectivity on the full map.
residual_risks: The packaged result does not give an explicit global bijection between the two classes or enumerate other iterates.
